content.text: Section 21 fully matches the preferred position; no redline needed.

input.quote: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21.1 sets a mutual aggregate cap at the greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, matching our preferred position (and the floor is not illusory: "Fees" in Section 1.5 covers recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, and Section 2.1 commits USD 2,000,000 of Services per year, so 12 months' Fees will exceed the USD 1,000,000 floor). Section 21.2 gives a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and helpfully confirms data restoration, replacement services, notification and incident-response costs are direct damages. Section 21.3 defines "Excluded Claims" to cover confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP, and those claims are carved out of both the cap (21.1) and the damages exclusion (21.2), so indemnities sit outside the cap. Section 21.3 also confirms Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees is not "damages" and is not limited by the Section, and Section 21.4 preserves each cap on failure of an exclusive remedy. Nothing here is one-sided against Customer, so no redline is warranted.
